note: SYNTHETIC. Every injected value was chosen to exercise a declared threshold. None is a measurement, and none supports a claim about how any real hardware behaves.

ACTUATOR_NO_RESPONSE.description: motor commanded and transmitted; current collapses
ACTUATOR_NO_RESPONSE.expectation_written_before_the_run: ACT_NO_ELECTRICAL_RESPONSE; ESC, power path and wiring named as inseparable candidates

CLOCK_DRIFT.description: validity stamps run ahead of arrival stamps
CLOCK_DRIFT.expectation_written_before_the_run: TIMING_CLOCK_INCONSISTENT, VIOLATED; no latency is published from stamps shown to be inconsistent

CPU_OVERLOAD.description: CPU load rises; estimator runtime and latency follow
CPU_OVERLOAD.expectation_written_before_the_run: COMPUTE degrades then violates; TIMING follows; functions with a no-degradation TIMING requirement stop first

ESTIMATOR_LATE.description: sources fresh; estimator runtime exceeds its deadline
ESTIMATOR_LATE.expectation_written_before_the_run: COMPUTE/TIMING limitation; SENSOR domain remains exactly what v1.1 said it was

NETWORK_LATENCY.description: telemetry transport delay and queue delay rise
NETWORK_LATENCY.expectation_written_before_the_run: COMMUNICATION and TIMING degrade; SENSOR stays source-valid; TELEMETRY is limited, navigation is not

NOMINAL.description: every declared signal inside every declared threshold
NOMINAL.expectation_written_before_the_run: SYSTEM NORMAL; no adverse evidence; attribution NO_EVIDENCE

PACKET_LOSS.description: GNSS serial link loses messages and falls below rate
PACKET_LOSS.expectation_written_before_the_run: COMMUNICATION is the candidate; the link failure is NOT reported as a sensor failure

POWER_SAG.description: battery terminal voltage collapses under unchanged load
POWER_SAG.expectation_written_before_the_run: POWER limits functions; the BATTERY is the candidate and the rails follow it, so the source is NOT exonerated

PROCESS_STALL.description: estimator heartbeat and output age grow without bound
PROCESS_STALL.expectation_written_before_the_run: process_alive VIOLATED; the functions that need it become INELIGIBLE; the sensor domain is untouched

REGULATOR_FAILURE.description: 5 V rail leaves tolerance; battery untouched
REGULATOR_FAILURE.expectation_written_before_the_run: distribution/regulator candidate; battery affirmatively nominal and named as exonerated

SHARED_RAIL.description: one rail out of tolerance with several dependants
SHARED_RAIL.expectation_written_before_the_run: AMBIGUOUS with the rail retained as a common-cause alternative, NOT adopted as the answer

SHARED_SOURCE.description: battery droops past its declared limit while the REAL v1.1 payload has two sources alarming on that same node
SHARED_SOURCE.expectation_written_before_the_run: AMBIGUOUS with POWER/battery retained as the common cause of two SENSOR candidates; v1.1's own function verdicts are unchanged, because a sequential alarm is not a cause

STALLED_ACTUATOR.description: command sent, ESC receives, current rises, RPM does not
STALLED_ACTUATOR.expectation_written_before_the_run: ACT_STALLED: a mechanical/load candidate, distinct from the no-current signature

TS_REGULATOR_FAILURE.description: 5 V logic rail fails; supply healthy
TS_REGULATOR_FAILURE.expectation_written_before_the_run: same exoneration as the aircraft profile, with no aviation code involved

TS_STALLED.description: drive current rises, shaft does not turn, torque falls

TS_SUPPLY_SAG.expectation_written_before_the_run: POWER limits TORQUE_DELIVERY and the sequence function
